WoW: Forever

Discipline Priest

Shields and mitigation rather than repair: "there cannot be Light without Dark." The spec is built on Power Word: ShieldPower Word: ShieldLevel 6 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 10CastInstantCost45 ManaRange40 yd rangeCooldown4 sec cooldownDuration30 secDraws on the soul of the party member to shield them, absorbing 48 damage. Lasts 30 sec. While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be interrupted by damage. Once shielded, the target cannot be shielded again for 15 sec., an absorb that stops damage before it lands. Soul WardingSoul WardingTalentCastInstantReduces the cooldown on your Power Word: Shield spell by 4 sec and reduces its mana cost by 15%. cuts its cooldown and Mana cost, PenancePenanceLevel 30 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost150 ManaRange36 yd range, 40 yd on alliesCooldown12 sec cooldownLaunches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 45 Holy damage to an enemy, or 134 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec. is the heal-or-nuke on a 12-second cooldown, and Power InfusionPower InfusionTalentCastInstantCost20% of base ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration15 secInfuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by 20% for 15 sec. sits at the top of the tree.

WoW: Forever · Healer · Updated November 13, 2026 · Client build 1.60.1.70938 · Null Ossuary

A guide to the live game, levels 1 to 60, checked against client 1.60.1.70938 on November 13, 2026. Talent rows open at 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40, one point a level from 10, 51 points at 60. The one-point talents are gated on points spent in the tree, not on level. Talent rows, ranks and numbers are read from the client. Blizzard's September 30 Class Deep Dive, its November 2 notes and its launch hotfixes outrank the client and the guide sites. Every talent build below is a published one, named and dated. They were written between November 4 and November 10, in the first week of the live game. No raid opens before December 9, 2026, so the level-60 builds rest on their authors' judgement and on no raid log. Where a tooltip differs from the text, go by the text: tooltips can lag a hotfix.

What Discipline is for

Preventing damage instead of repairing it. Power Word: ShieldPower Word: ShieldLevel 6 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 10CastInstantCost45 ManaRange40 yd rangeCooldown4 sec cooldownDuration30 secDraws on the soul of the party member to shield them, absorbing 48 damage. Lasts 30 sec. While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be interrupted by damage. Once shielded, the target cannot be shielded again for 15 sec. absorbs the hit before it lands, and Soul WardingSoul WardingTalentCastInstantReduces the cooldown on your Power Word: Shield spell by 4 sec and reduces its mana cost by 15%. cuts that shield's cooldown and its Mana cost. Divine AegisDivine AegisTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstant leaves a fresh absorb behind every critical heal. PenancePenanceLevel 30 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost150 ManaRange36 yd range, 40 yd on alliesCooldown12 sec cooldownLaunches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 45 Holy damage to an enemy, or 134 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec. channels damage or healing each second on a 12-second cooldown. From 40 at the earliest, Power InfusionPower InfusionTalentCastInstantCost20% of base ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration15 secInfuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by 20% for 15 sec. gives one ally 20% spell damage and healing for 15 seconds.

The same mechanic is the solo pattern: shield and wand. Power Word: ShieldPower Word: ShieldLevel 6 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 10CastInstantCost45 ManaRange40 yd rangeCooldown4 sec cooldownDuration30 secDraws on the soul of the party member to shield them, absorbing 48 damage. Lasts 30 sec. While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be interrupted by damage. Once shielded, the target cannot be shielded again for 15 sec. absorbs the damage, your wand does the killing, and you spend almost no Mana. Wowhead's levelling page calls the result "near-unkillable" and lists the cost: "Rotation is dominated by auto-attacking with your wand early on."

Icy Veins' ratings: Overall 4.5, Levelling 2.5, Dungeon 5.0, Utility 4.0, Mobility 1.0. The levelling number measures solo kill speed and nothing else. Its heading is "No AoE, Struggles To Solo Level": "Discipline Priest has decent single-target damage, but they lack in AoE damage. It's typically recommended to play with a group if you plan to level as Discipline, otherwise it is a better idea to primarily use Shadow talents until you're able to get into group content."

The two sites do not agree on how slow it is. Wowhead's levelling page (November 4) calls Discipline "a reasonable choice to level as" and "slightly slower" than Shadow, most of all past 40. Icy Veins recommends Shadow talents for a solo player. Both agree it is the easier of the two healing specs to solo with, because its tree carries damage talents.

If you are levelling in groups, you do not need Shadow. Icy Veins rates Discipline 5.0 out of 5 for dungeons. Blizzard trimmed dungeon quest experience before launch: "Dungeon quests now reward 50% less extra experience beyond normal quest values". On November 8 it raised kill experience inside dungeons by 50%.

A respec is a trainer visit. Icy Veins puts the first at 1 gold, rising each time. Dual Specialization is bought from the class trainer at level 40 for 50 gold (Wowhead's report; Blizzard gives the level and no price).

Keep a low rank of RenewRenewLevel 8 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 10CastInstantCost30 ManaRange40 yd rangeDuration15 secHeals the target of 45 damage over 15 sec. and HealHealLevel 16 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 4Cast3 sec castCost155 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeal your target for 260 to 300. on your bars. Wowhead says a lower rank is often the more efficient cast and that the game penalises ranks learned more than 18 levels ago. Doublezug's launch-week video makes the same case for levelling dungeons: low ranks on damage dealers and on yourself, top ranks for a tank taking heavy damage (one creator's advice, at 4:05). Low ranks lose no talent procs in Forever.

Multi-target: Prayer of HealingPrayer of HealingLevel 30 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 5Cast3 sec castCost410 ManaRange40 yd rangeA powerful prayer that heals the target and their party for 179 to 191. Party members must be within 40 yards of target. is the only area heal. Icy Veins: "The only thing that Discipline lacks is group/AoE healing." These effects cause no threat. is a Holy talent some Discipline builds take.

Stat priority

Healing, Icy Veins' order: Healing Power, MP5, Spirit, Intellect, critical strike.

Healing, Wowhead's order: Healing Power, Intellect, Spirit, critical strike. Wowhead labels its list speculative and wrote it before launch.

They differ on Intellect. Both give the same numbers: 15 Mana a point, and about 59 Intellect for 1% spell crit. Spirit regenerates Spirit divided by 4, plus 12.5, Mana every 2 seconds when you have not cast for 5 seconds, and MeditationMeditationTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantAllows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting. keeps half of that running while you cast.

Critical strike is worth more here than on Holy: Divine AegisDivine AegisTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstant and InspirationInspirationTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantYour non-periodic critical heals increase your target's Armor by 25% for 15 sec. trigger off critical heals, and Renewed HopeRenewed HopeTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantYour heals from Flash Heal, Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, and Penance gain 10% increased critical strike chance when cast on targets with Weakened Soul, and reduce the remaining duration of Weakened Soul on their target by 5 sec. raises the crit chance feeding them. Icy Veins makes that point on its stat page.

Do not itemise Hit for healing gear. Holy PrecisionHoly PrecisionTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantImproves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%. grants up to 18% Holy spell hit from the talent tree alone. Blizzard states the intent outright: the talent exists "to remove the need for hit chance on healing Priests, who are not expected to wear gear that increased hit chance."

For Smite damage: SmiteSmiteLevel 1 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 8Cast1.5 sec castCost20 ManaRange30 yd rangeSmite an enemy for 13 to 18 Holy damage., Holy FireHoly FireLevel 20 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 8Cast3.5 sec castCost85 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration10 secConsumes the enemy in holy flames that cause 53 to 65 Holy damage and an additional 20 Holy damage over 10 sec. and PenancePenanceLevel 30 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost150 ManaRange36 yd range, 40 yd on alliesCooldown12 sec cooldownLaunches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 45 Holy damage to an enemy, or 134 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec. are Holy spells, so Holy PrecisionHoly PrecisionTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantImproves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%. 3/3 covers the 17% a caster needs against a raid boss. No site publishes a stat order for a Smite build.

The one-third figure belongs to a talent, not to gear. Spiritual GuidanceSpiritual GuidanceTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases your spell healing by up to 25% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to 8% of your total Spirit. in the Holy tree gives a bonus to spell damage "approximately one third as much as the bonus to spell healing"; nothing in Blizzard's post makes healing bonus on gear grant spell damage.

What nobody has measured: whether stacked absorbs beat raw healing in a raid. Wowhead's rotation page says plainly that it has not seen endgame content. Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit and Onyxia's Lair open on December 9, 2026.
